youtube.description:
Kiro steering modes explained: Always, FileMatch, Manual, Auto

Four ways Kiro loads your steering rules.

1. Always - Included in every request.
2. File match - Loads when matching files are in play.
3. Manual - Loads only when you call it.
4. Auto - Kiro picks it when it fits the task.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/steering/
